change_reason: Expanded previously stated ticket budgets into explicit machine-readable fields; no numeric threshold changed. Required before semantic candidate measurements.
matched_baseline: raw NAR with transparent filesystem compression
operational_invariants: No resident database or GC worker.
Verify, GC, recovery, and repack are deterministic offline operations.
Compaction uses one configured segment plus reserve and never a second full-cache copy.
Backup restore into an empty DATA directory passes reconcile and independent Nix verification.
Authorization tests cover read/write capability separation and logs contain no secrets.
stop_rules: Do not tune thresholds after observing candidate results.
Do not call a quick smoke run decision evidence.
A 25-50 percent result selects the simpler design only when every hard gate passes.
Record host, filesystem, kernel, CPU governor, commit, tool versions, cache state, and exact command.
